title: fct_orders - a clean incremental model
description: The control case: incremental with a guard, a unique_key, an explicit column list, a documented grain and real tests.

title: fct_customer_orders - fanout over two detail tables
description: Joins orders and order items, then counts and sums. The classic double-counting bug, plus a grain column with no unique test.

title: fct_events - incremental with no guard
description: Declared incremental but has no is_incremental() guard and no unique_key, so every run appends the whole table again.

title: legacy_sales_daily - hard-coded tables, select *, limit
description: A legacy hand-written model: literal database.schema tables, select *, a hard-coded date and a limit that silently truncates the data.

title: fct_orders_enriched - LEFT JOIN filtered in WHERE
description: A LEFT JOIN whose right-hand relation is filtered in WHERE, which quietly turns it into an INNER JOIN and drops unmatched orders.

title: DIM_CUSTOMERS - an undocumented view
description: Upper-case view over literal tables, no schema.yml at all, a reserved word as a column name and a magic number in the HAVING clause.
